name: Woven Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: woven

sections.description:
The Woven Payment Gateway for WooCommerce empowers your store with a secure and easy-to-use payment solution. Accept payments through Woven with minimal setup and provide a smooth checkout experience for your customers.

  • Easy Setup: Quickly configure your Woven payment gateway from the WooCommerce settings.
  • Seamless Integration: Woven works perfectly with your WooCommerce checkout flow.
  • Secure Payments: Transactions are encrypted, ensuring a secure experience for your users.

External Services

This plugin integrates with Woven’s payment service API to facilitate payment processing.

  • Service Name: Woven Payment Service
  • Purpose: To process online payments securely via Woven’s API.
  • Data Sent:
    • User’s payment information during checkout.
    • Store API credentials for authentication.
    • Transaction details required for payment processing.
  • When Data is Sent: Data is sent when a user initiates a transaction at checkout.
  • Privacy Policy: For detailed information about how Woven handles data, please refer to their Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the woven-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Go to Plugins in your WordPress admin panel and activate the plugin.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments and enable Woven Payment Gateway.
  4. Enter your Woven API keys to connect your account and start processing payments.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the Woven Payment Gateway?

Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments, select Woven Payment Gateway, and enter your API keys to configure the plugin.

Is Woven Payment Gateway secure?

Yes, all transactions are securely encrypted using the latest standards.

How can I uninstall the plugin?

To uninstall, deactivate the plugin from the Plugins page and then delete it.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Improved Woven checkout initialization and payment setup reliability.
  • Added callback URL support when starting a Woven payment.
  • Improved amount and phone number formatting before sending checkout data to Woven.
  • Added optional WooCommerce debug logging for troubleshooting.
  • Added clearer order notes for Woven payment initiation, callbacks, verification success, and verification failure.
  • Declared compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

1.0.0

  • Initial release of the Woven Payment Gateway plugin for WooCommerce.
